name: Coda
description: An all-in-one collaborative workspace that blends documents, spreadsheets, and applications into a single canvas.

evidence.claim: Coda has a REST API with documentation covering documents, pages, tables, rows, etc.
Python wrapper codaio uses API keys for authentication.
Coda supports OAuth2 authentication for integrations and packs.
Community MCP servers exist for Coda, providing tools to interact with Coda documents and pages.

notes: Coda provides a robust REST API capable of managing documents, pages, tables, rows, formulas, and more. Community MCP servers and Python wrappers are readily available.
